Name: Jahaziel, Priest
Summary: Priest with trumpets continually before the ark of the covenant of God, with Benaiah.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 16:6: Priest with trumpets continually before the ark of the covenant of God, with Benaiah.
LifeLesson: The mention of Jahaziel in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.
